title: Format cents as currency with a caller-chosen compact form
task: Implement `FormatCents(cents int64) string` in package `money` that renders 123456 as "$1,234.56" and negative amounts as "-$1,234.56". Some callers want a compact rendering that drops the cents when they are zero, so 120000 becomes "$1,200" while 120050 still becomes "$1,200.50"; let the caller choose the compact output. Both renderings must share the thousands-grouping logic rather than each doing its own. Write tests for zero, a negative amount, and grouping past a million.
